title: Express a harness change as a testable hypothesis
narrative: Taloneth writes the failure mode and expected metric before shipping a harness tweak, then evaluates with and without the change. Accepts inspiration requirement 14[^insp-r14].
implementation: `HarnessExperiment` carries hypothesis, intervention, failure_mode, evidence, and `to_trace_fields` for version/assignment on traces.
validation: Kind `harness_experiment_retire`. Soft expects retired when treatment loses (evidence-driven retain/retire).
